rules.title: Minimum Distance Separation
rules.calculation: Compute 60 dBu service contour distance; compare against §73.207 Table 1 minimum spacing for co-channel and adjacent-channel stations within search radius
rules.pass_condition: All co-channel and adjacent-channel stations meet minimum distance separation per Table 1
rules.fail_condition: Any co-channel or adjacent-channel station violates minimum distance separation
rules.confidence_basis: Deterministic — same inputs always produce same output

rules.title: FM Short-Spacing / Contour Protection (Waiver Basis)
rules.calculation: When §73.207 spacing fails, evaluate whether a §73.215 short-spacing showing can be made: confirm the station fails §73.207 minimum separation but has executed an interference protection agreement or demonstrates contour non-overlap under §73.215 criteria
rules.pass_condition: §73.215 waiver criteria are met: contour protection ratios do not overlap any protected station's contour OR an interference protection agreement is in place
rules.fail_condition: Contour overlap with a protected station exists and no §73.215 waiver basis applies
rules.confidence_basis: Deterministic — same contour engine inputs produce same output

rules.title: HAAT Computation (Height Above Average Terrain)
rules.calculation: Arc-average method over 8 radials (0°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 180°, 225°, 270°, 315°) at 3–16 km from the transmitter site using ITM terrain model. Mean of 8 per-radial HAAT values is the terrain-derived advisory HAAT. Filing HAAT is operator-supplied or FCC-accepted value.
rules.pass_condition: Filing HAAT is consistent with terrain-derived advisory HAAT (within 20%); all 8 radials computed
rules.fail_condition: Filing HAAT diverges from terrain-derived advisory HAAT by >20% (HAAT_DISCREPANCY warning, not blocker)
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH when ITM terrain sidecar runs successfully; MEDIUM when operator-supplied

rules.title: FM Class ERP Limits
rules.calculation: Look up the maximum authorized ERP for the station's FCC class from the §73.211 class ERP table: A=6 kW, B1=25 kW, B=50 kW, C0/C1/C=100 kW, C2=50 kW, C3=25 kW. Compare station_inputs.erp_kw against the class maximum.

rules.rule: 47 CFR §73.316 (FM antenna systems); FCC Form 301 technical data (coordinates)
rules.title: FM Antenna Systems and Transmitter Coordinate Data
rules.calculation: Validate transmitter coordinates are within US territory (NAD83) — a Form 301 technical-data sanity check, not a §73.316 requirement. When station_inputs.pattern is present, classify antenna as DA (directional) vs ND (non-directional). DA pattern table must be provided per §73.316 for Form 301-FM Section III.
rules.pass_condition: Coordinates within US service territory; DA pattern table present when station_inputs.pattern is non-empty
rules.fail_condition: Coordinates outside US territory; or DA station missing pattern table
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH for coordinate range check; MEDIUM for pattern classification

rules.title: Tower Height, Obstruction Marking, and ASR Registration
rules.calculation: Determine tower overall height AGL from ASR (preferred) or operator input. Structures >60.96 m (200 ft) AGL require FAA Notice of Proposed Construction (Form 7460-1) and may require ASR registration. ASR record provides authoritative height, painting, and lighting requirements.
rules.pass_condition: Tower height > 0 and <= 60.96 m (no FAA notice required); or >60.96 m with valid FAA/ASR records present
rules.fail_condition: Tower height is 0 or negative (physically impossible); height >60.96 m with no ASR/FAA evidence
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH when ASR record present; MEDIUM when operator-supplied only

rules.title: RF Exposure Evaluation (Maximum Permissible Exposure)
rules.calculation: Compute controlled and uncontrolled MPE boundaries using OET-65 methodology. For FM: compute the horizontal distance at which power density drops below 1 mW/cm² (controlled) and 0.2 mW/cm² (uncontrolled). Compare against transmitter site boundaries.
rules.pass_condition: MPE boundaries fall within transmitter site fence line; no public access within uncontrolled zone
rules.fail_condition: MPE boundary extends beyond transmitter site boundary; near-field evaluation required
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH when oet65 block present; advisory gap when absent

rules.title: AM Groundwave Field Strength
rules.calculation: Compute daytime groundwave field strength using FCC M3 propagation curves (conductivity-based). Determine the distance at which the 0.5 mV/m daytime service contour is reached, and check against §73.183 groundwave protection requirements for co-channel and adjacent-channel AM stations.
rules.pass_condition: Groundwave 0.5 mV/m service contour does not encroach upon another station's 0.5 mV/m protected contour
rules.fail_condition: Groundwave service contour overlaps a co-channel or adjacent-channel protected contour
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH when SOMNEC2D/FCCGW physics run; MEDIUM when M3 curve-only

rules.title: AM Nighttime Skywave Protection (NIF Contour)
rules.calculation: Compute nighttime interference-free (NIF) contour using FCC skywave propagation model. Determine which Class A and B stations require protection from the subject station's skywave. Evaluate whether the subject station's 0.5 mV/m nighttime skywave contour (50% time/10% locations) encroaches on a protected station's 0.5 mV/m contour.
rules.pass_condition: Subject station's nighttime skywave does not degrade any protected station's 0.5 mV/m NIF contour
rules.fail_condition: Nighttime skywave interferes with one or more protected AM stations
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH when NIF contour engine runs with verified skywave model

rules.title: AM Antenna Input Power and Class Power Limits
rules.calculation: Validate that day/night antenna input power does not exceed class maximums per §73.184 table. For directional arrays, verify that the licensed RMS field is consistent with the antenna design and that the transmitter power delivered to the antenna system meets §73.1560 operating power tolerance (±10% for AM).
rules.pass_condition: Day and night power within class maximums; transmitter operating power within ±10% of licensed value
rules.fail_condition: Power exceeds class maximum; or operating power out of ±10% tolerance
rules.confidence_basis: HIGH — deterministic table lookup for class power; MEDIUM for operating tolerance
